name: cogni-workspace
description: The horizontal layer of the insight-wave marketplace — it owns the shared workspace state the vertical business plugins consume. Manages shared infrastructure (env vars, settings), MCP server installation and Desktop config patching, plugin discovery, the supported-markets registry, project discovery, workspace health and diagnostics, an interactive workspace-configuration dashboard, Obsidian vault integration, issue reporting, and cross-plugin claim verification — submitting sourced assertions, verifying them against their cited URLs, and guiding deviation resolution. The theme lifecycle, narrative composition and copywriting are owned by cogni-publishing; this plugin keeps same-name compatibility routes to it.
